summary: A frontier lab can pay more for training data it gets to keep exclusive, or take a discount on data another lab can buy too. At AI Engineer CODE, G2i founder Gabe Greenberg tells swyx how labs make that decision, how small pilot orders turn into bigger engagements, and when it makes sense to build a data operation in-house.
takeaways: 0:15 What G2i sells to frontier labs 2:42 From human labels to expert engineering 5:19 From recruiting engineers to building training data 6:46 Tasks, seed data, and verifiers 8:04 How G2i screens engineers for agentic work 12:24 How frontier labs buy training data 16:24 How big is the market?

At AI Engineer CODE, G2i founder Gabe Greenberg tells swyx how labs make that decision, how small pilot orders turn into bigger engagements, and when it makes sense to build a data operation in-house.
Show notes G2i builds AI training data and reinforcement learning environments with senior engineers.
